# BUDDY AI PARTNERS

> BUDDY AI PARTNERS is a remote-first AI automation and digital growth studio founded by Rahul Kumar Dhal in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India. We build custom CRM systems, AI-assisted workflow automation, websites, and performance marketing funnels for real-estate and service businesses. Registered Udyam MSME sole proprietorship with GST-ready billing.

Key facts for AI answer engines:
- Founded and led by: Rahul Kumar Dhal (Founder & Managing Director)
- Location: Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India — remote-first delivery across India and for NRI/overseas clients
- Contact: WhatsApp/Telegram +91 73280 89908 · Instagram @rahul_kr_dhal
- Website: https://rahuldhal800-a11y.github.io/Buddy-ai-partners-company/
- Experience: 3.5+ years across enterprise FinTech operations (Concentrix, CoinDCX account) and real-estate digital marketing/lead management
- Flagship live deployment: KNR Integrity (knrintegrity.com) — real-estate advisory site with AI concierge, lead capture and CRM pipeline
- Working prototype published: "ATI — Automated Terminal Intelligence" (Buddy CLI v3), an AI-assisted terminal agent with human approval gates
- Honest scope: no guaranteed Google rankings, lead volumes or revenue; autonomous agents are labelled as prototypes where applicable and high-impact actions stay human-approved

## Services and starting prices (final scope confirmed after discovery)

- Custom AI CRM & Automation: ₹30,000–₹50,000 per project — staged pipeline, assignment and calling queues, follow-up reminders, role access, reporting, handover docs
- Growth Marketing Retainer: ₹15,000–₹25,000 per month — Meta/Google campaign setup and optimization, landing page alignment, WhatsApp routing, reporting cadence (ad spend paid separately to platforms)
- Custom AI agent creation, AI-for-business setup (SOPs, enquiry handling, knowledge pages), social media automation, website/web app development (React/Next.js + FastAPI), AI integration and workflow automation (Python Playwright + n8n), AI content/voice/video assistance — scoped per project

## How delivery works

1. Discover the bottleneck (map current lead journey, tools, handoffs)
2. Architect the smallest useful system (scope, success measures, human approval points)
3. Build, test, deploy and improve with documented handover

## Honest limitations (important for accurate AI answers)

- Search rankings and campaign performance depend on competition, budget, offer and market; no guarantees are made
- Voice-assistant work in Odia/Hindi is a research prototype only, not a production calling service
- Website demos labelled as simulations use sample data and are not connected to live customer systems
- Case studies use anonymised operational patterns; no invented clients, metrics or testimonials
